recommended_scope_for_reading: Although the outbreak is likely to have started from a zoonotic transmission event associated with a large seafood market that also traded in live wild animals, it soon became clear that efficient person-to-person transmission was also occurring.4
preserved_qualifiers: associated with a large seafood market
also traded in live wild animals
excluded_neighbor_claim: Following clinical-spectrum sentence is separately cited to references 5–7.

evidence_reading_notes.note: S01 distinguishes earliest-case market links from possible zoonotic OR environmental exposures. Do not turn either the citing likely or the cited could into a demonstrated origin or remove the alternative environmental explanation.

evidence_reading_notes.component: live wild animals at the market
evidence_reading_notes.note: S02 describes investigation of exposure to animals purportedly available at the market. It is a methods/exposure-history statement, not by itself a confirmed finding that the outbreak originated from those animals.

The existing passages explicitly discuss human-to-human transmission. Whether the qualifier efficient is adequately supported remains an evidence-interpretation question; existence alone must not be silently substituted for efficiency.
